title: DataAgent, which is developing AI agents that autonomously fix failures inside companies' own cloud infrastructure, emerges from stealth with a $10M pre-seed (CTech)
summary: CTech: DataAgent, which is developing AI agents that autonomously fix failures inside companies' own cloud infrastructure, emerges from stealth with a $10M pre-seed — The Israeli startup is taking aim at the cost and complexity of observability by putting autonomous agents directly inside production environments.
